name: Beijing Sinnet Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Beijing Sinnet Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides internet data center (IDC), cloud computing, internet broadband access, and other internet solutions in China and Hong Kong. The company offers data center value-added services, including data center renovation, line, and operation and maintenance value-added services, as well as office and park services; and customized data center services. It also provides cloud computing solutions, such as amazon cloud technology and cloud value-added services; intelligent computing services; and various types of internet access services, including single-line, multi-line access, and other internet services.
